name: Wheat (गेहूं / கோதுமை / ਕਣਕ / గోధుమలు)
waterDesc: 4-6 irrigations (Crown Root Initiation, Tillering, Flowering, Grain filling)
tips: Sow treated seeds (HD-2967, PBW-550 or DBW-187). Apply balanced NPK (120:60:40 kg/ha). Protect from yellow rust during cool humid mornings.

name: Mustard / Sarson (सरसों / கடுகு / ਸਰ੍ਹੋਂ / ఆవాలు)
waterDesc: 2-3 light irrigations (Flower initiation and pod formation)
tips: Excellent low-water cash crop with high oil content. Suitable varieties: Pusa Mustard 25, RH-749, Giriraj. Monitor for aphids during cloudy spells.

name: Paddy / Rice (धान / நெல் / ਝੋਨਾ / వరి)
waterDesc: Continuous shallow standing water (5cm) or Alternate Wetting & Drying (AWD)
tips: Adopt Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) or Alternate Wetting Drying to save up to 30% water and reduce methane emissions. Recommended: PR-126, Pusa 44, Basmati 1121.

name: Chickpea / Desi Chana (चना / கொண்டைக்கடலை / ਛੋਲੇ / శనగలు)
waterDesc: 1-2 life-saving irrigations. Highly sensitive to excess water.
tips: Natural nitrogen fixer that enriches soil fertility for the next crop. Varieties: JG-11, GNG-1581, Pusa 372. Treat seed with Rhizobium culture before sowing.

name: Cotton (कपास / பருத்தி / ਕਪਾਹ / పత్తి)
waterDesc: 4-5 irrigations during squaring, flowering and boll formation.
tips: Install pheromone traps (5/acre) for pink bollworm monitoring. Drip irrigation saves 45% water and increases boll size.

name: Maize / Makka (मक्का / மக்காச்சோளம் / ਮੱਕੀ / మొక్కజొన్న)
waterDesc: 3-4 irrigations at knee-high, tasseling and grain milking stages.
tips: Dual-purpose crop for grain cash sale and nutrient-rich cattle green fodder/silage. Recommended: Pioneer 3396, DKC 9108, PMH-1.

name: Moong / Green Gram (मूंग / பாசிப்பயறு / ਮੂੰਗੀ / పెసలు)
waterDesc: 2-3 light irrigations. Short duration catch crop.
tips: Ideal 60-day summer crop between wheat harvest and paddy transplanting. Adds 35-40 kg nitrogen/ha to soil. Varieties: SML-668, IPM 205-7 (Virat).

name: Bajra / Pearl Millet (बाजरा / கம்பு / ਬਾਜਰਾ / సజ్జలు)
waterDesc: 1-2 life saving irrigations, thrives predominantly on monsoon rains.
tips: Extreme drought tolerance. Nutri-cereal high in iron and zinc. High cattle dry fodder value. Varieties: HHB-67 Improved, MPMH-17.
